bug_semantics: OliveTin renders action command templates through a process-wide text/template.Template singleton. Concurrent ExecRequest goroutines call Parse then Execute on that same instance with no Clone, mutex, or per-call New. One goroutine can overwrite the shared template tree while another Execute walks it, producing cross-request command contamination, wrong-argument shell execution, and unrecoverable concurrent map writes in Go text/template internals.
flaw_origin: The first write of the shared-template race is 6b342cbedb041f515a76495cec69f9979bd34d1e, which added service/internal/entities/templates.go with package-level var tpl = template.New("tpl") and ParseTemplateWithArgs doing t, err := tpl.Parse(source) then t.Execute. Parent 17c716c599b5a11f0bb01d18827014b868a53280 has no that path and no text/template usage; it substituted {{ args }} with strings.ReplaceAll. Later b37f035ea653e6f238a7cdfa0f636f518a692dc4 moved the same singleton into service/internal/tpl/templates.go, and b777d599aa1869871d67eb43cf64908d513976ee extracted parseTemplate still calling tpl.Parse. Fix d74da9314005954dd49fa20dabf272247bc76519 clones before Parse.
